Electric field, ions, and flames
Why microgravity?
Background and motivation
• Hydrocarbon flame’s inherent electrical property
was reported more than two centuries ago.
• Most of the theories with regard to the electrical
charge carriers and ionization process were not
extensively elaborated until after the 1950s.
• The book, written by Lawton and Weinberg, on
the electrical aspects of combustion integrated
the knowledge at the time (1969) of a flame’s
systematic ion generation as well as electrical
control of flames based on laboratory tests and
observations.
• Pederson and Brown (among others) identified
chemi-ionization mechanisms in hydrocarbon
flames in 1993.
